d001.note: p051 zoom at 1400 dpi: عَلانِيتُهُ has fatha on ع, kasra under ن, damma on ت and on ه; no fatha on the ي.

d002.note: p052 zoom at 1600 dpi: أَقْترَفَ has fatha on أ, sukun on ق, fatha on ر and on ف; nothing above the ت (only its two dots).

extra_edits.note: Both keyers wrote two fathas. A 2400 dpi zoom shows only one fatha, over the ع, and nothing above the ل stem. The other عَلَى on this page (أَنَّ اللهَ عَلَى كُلِّ) clearly has both fathas at the same zoom. Written as printed (CONVENTIONS §2).
